llm.summary: This is a Markdown-only video storyboard guidance skill with visible Chinese-language creative instructions and no code execution, credential access, network behavior, or persistence.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request filesystem, network, tool, credential, account, or local-profile access, which is proportionate for a guidance-only creative skill.

dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.label: Install Mechanism

dimensions.detail: The load triggers include broad video-conversion phrases and the documentation is Chinese-only; both are visible quality and activation-scope issues, but the loaded behavior remains limited to the disclosed storyboard workflow.

llm.guidance: Reasonable to install if you want Chinese-language storyboard guidance. Before publishing broadly, consider narrowing the trigger wording and adding an explicit language/locale note so non-Chinese users are not surprised.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger wording was confirmed, but it is purpose-adjacent for video/storyboard requests and has no high-impact side effects; treat it as an activation precision note rather than a security concern.
[SQP-3] unexpected: The Chinese-only documentation and examples were confirmed across the main skill and reference files; this is a visible localization limitation for broad users, not hidden or unsafe agent behavior.
